title: Add first-class 'devstack restart' CLI command
description: Agents got confused asking to restart a service because the CLI only had start/stop (restart existed only as an MCP tool + tunnel subcommand). Added cmd/restart_cmd.go: 'devstack restart [service|group]' mirroring MCP restart semantics — re-enable if disabled, then tilt trigger the target only (not its deps). Supports cwd auto-detect and SilenceUsage. Verified live on navexa: restart <service>, restart <group>, and cwd auto-detect all work.

title: De-Tilt: remove user-facing Tilt references (full rebrand incl. flags)
description: Hide 'Tilt' from all user- and agent-facing surfaces; present as 'dev daemon'/'devstack'. Targets: internal/tilt/client.go error msg + test; cmd/down_cmd.go 'Tilt stopped'; MCP tool descriptions in internal/mcp/tools.go + tools_environment.go (via Tilt/Tilt resource/Tilt-managed/registered in Tilt); cmd/register.go flag help 'Tilt API port'; env vars TILT_PORT/TILT_HOST -> DEVSTACK_DAEMON_* (keep old as fallback); flags --dashboard-port/-host -> --daemon-port/-host. Keep internal Go identifiers (internal/tilt pkg, TiltPort field) unchanged — not user-facing. Verify: grep shows no user-facing 'Tilt'; build/test/install; devstack up/status/down output uses devstack terms.
close_reason: De-Tilt rebrand: client.go daemon error + test; down_cmd 'Dev daemon stopped'; all MCP tool descriptions (status/restart/stop/process_logs/configure/investigate/environment) de-Tilted; register.go + init.go help; flags --dashboard-port/-host -> --daemon-port/-host; env TILT_PORT/HOST -> DEVSTACK_DAEMON_PORT/HOST with legacy fallback; init.go generated config emits DEVSTACK_DAEMON_PORT. Only remaining 'Tiltfile' ref is init.go:292 (genuine file read, resolved by manifest work). Verified: build/vet/test pass, install, --daemon-port shows, daemon-down msg in devstack terms, env fallback works.

title: Manifest-driven workspace config + Tiltfile generation; migrate navexa
description: Make a workspace fully self-contained in devstack manifests (devstack.workspace.yaml + per-service devstack.service.yaml) and GENERATE the Tiltfile from them so it's never hand-edited. Steps: extend manifest schema to cover all Tiltfile features navexa uses (serve_cmd/dir/env, readiness probe, cmd/free_port, trigger_mode/auto_init, labels, links, resource_deps); build generator manifests->Tiltfile emitting local_resource blocks; hook generation into devstack up/start; migrate navexa's Tiltfile+.devstack.json into manifests and regenerate. Depends on manifest-system investigation. Verify: generated Tiltfile runs all navexa services; devstack status matches pre-migration.
notes: ADDED (user): workspace-level env.values map in devstack.workspace.yaml that trickles down to ALL services (for OTEL endpoint, DB connections, etc). Merge precedence low->high: (1) devstack-managed defaults incl auto-injected OTEL endpoint from otel config, (2) workspace env.values, (3) service env.values, (4) .envrc/env.files sourced at runtime. Service overrides workspace. Generator emits merged serve_env per service, eliminating per-service OTEL repetition. This + earlier decisions (groups drive labels; .envrc implicit; schema extensions prep/triggerMode/autoStart/watch/exec-healthcheck/links) define the full manifest model. Ready to build: schema -> generator -> validate on playground -> checkpoint before navexa.
close_reason: Delivered: (1) schema extensions (workspace env.values; service prep/triggerMode/autoStart/watch/exec+http healthcheck tuning/env.values/links) in manifests.go +test. (2) internal/tiltgen generator manifests->Tiltfile (groups->labels, deps->resource_deps, .envrc auto-source, managed OTEL env, prep/probe/links) +test. (3) devstack generate cmd + auto-regen hook in 'up' (guarded to manifest workspaces). (4) Migrated navexa: 1 workspace + 9 service manifests, backed up Tiltfile/.devstack.json, generated Tiltfile validated by 'tilt alpha tiltfile-result' (9 resources, no error) and devstack groups. (5) Educational scaffolding: workspace add bootstraps commented devstack.workspace.yaml; new 'workspace scaffold-service'. All verified: build/vet/test pass, round-trip scaffold->generate->tilt parse OK.

title: Add native tunnel command group (SSH port forwarding)
description: Port ~/tunnel.sh into devstack as a native 'devstack tunnel' command group. Discovers running service ports via existing Tilt EndpointLinks, launches detached ssh -R (push) / -L (pull) forwards, tracks PID files under the workspace runtime dir. Subcommands: push/pull/stop/status/list/restart. Persist default remote host/user in the workspace registry (~/.config/devstack/workspaces.json). Shell out to system ssh (reuses ~/.ssh/config). Verify: build passes, 'devstack tunnel list' shows discovered ports, push/pull spawn tracked ssh processes, stop kills them.
notes: Follow-ups: (1) push now forwards ONLY ports actually serving traffic (tunnel.Listening/PartitionServing TCP-dial check); dead ports skipped with [skip] lines. (2) Added MCP 'tunnel' tool (actions list/status/push/pull/stop/set-remote) with agent-facing description covering key-based SSH + serving-only + remembered remote; registered local-only in mcp.RegisterTools; serve help updated. (3) Added CLI 'devstack tunnel set-remote <host> --user' for config without a live connection. (4) Configured navexa workspace remote = nickfreemantle@macbook. Verified: unit tests (PartitionServing w/ real listener), live serving filter (8 skipped/1 attempted), MCP tools/list shows tunnel + tunnel list call works over stdio.
close_reason: Implemented devstack tunnel command group: internal/tunnel package (Tilt-based discovery, detached ssh -R/-L launch, pidfile tracking, /proc zombie-aware liveness, gentle SSH preflight w/ ssh-copy-id guidance), registry TunnelHost/TunnelUser persistence, cmd/tunnel_cmd.go (push/pull/stop/status/list/restart). Verified: go build/vet/test pass, unit tests for Discover/CheckConnectivity/Launch-KillPort lifecycle, live discovery against running Tilt, gentle guidance on auth failure, no-save of non-working remotes.
